proposals.name: HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts) Practitioners
proposals.buyer_persona: An active HEMA fencer who trains weekly with longswords or rapiers, loves medieval history treatises (Liechtenauer, Fiore dei Liberi), and wants to show off their niche sport through apparel, gear stickers, and training logs.
product_angles: Sarcastic diagrams of historical sword guards (e.g., 'Alber' or 'vom Tag') on Redbubble stickers
KDP Training Logbook specifically formatted for HEMA bouts, technique tracking, and tournament drills
3D printable sword hangers or custom pommel weight replicas on Cults3D
proposals.first_test_product: A KDP 'HEMA Combat & Sparring Logbook' with a vintage treatise-style cover generated via Flux (Together AI)

proposals.name: Ham Radio Operators & Shortwave Listeners (SWL)
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy hobbyists (often older or engineer-minded) who build antennas, collect 'QSL cards' from long-distance contacts, and communicate globally. They love technical insider jokes (Q-codes like QRM, QRT) and vintage radio aesthetics.
product_angles: KDP Amateur Radio Operator Logbook (mandatory for many to log contacts, but standard ones are boring)
Redbubble retro-style stickers featuring radio vacuum tubes, Morse code keys, and '73' (best regards) typography
Printable QSL card templates (digital download on Etsy or physical layouts on KDP)
proposals.first_test_product: A high-quality 'Amateur Radio Contact Logbook' with a clean, grid-based layout and a vintage schematics-style cover

proposals.name: Retro PS1-Style Low-Poly Textures for Indie Game Devs
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers building retro-horror or nostalgic 90s style games on Unity, Unreal, or Godot. They need seamless, pixelated dithered textures (brick, rust, sci-fi panels) to match the PSX aesthetic.
product_angles: Asset packs of 64x64 or 128x128 pixelated seamless textures generated via Together AI/Cloudflare and downscaled with Python scripts
Low-poly 3D models of retro environmental props (e.g., CRT monitors, industrial trash cans) on Cults3D or Itch.io
UI sprite sheets for retro-horror inventory systems
proposals.first_test_product: A pack of 50 seamless '90s Retro Industrial & Horror' textures hosted on Itch.io/Cults3D

proposals.name: Solo Board Gamers (Print & Play / Automa)
proposals.buyer_persona: Board game enthusiasts who prefer playing solo campaigns, tracking complex campaign states (e.g., Gloomhaven, Mage Knight, Arkham Horror LCG), and printing custom player aids, deck holders, or token organizers.
product_angles: KDP Solo Campaign Campaign Journals with trackers for custom scenarios, health, and card upgrades
3D printable minimalist card holders and token trays designed specifically for solo table layouts on Cults3D
Print-and-Play (P&P) custom solo dice/card game assets
proposals.first_test_product: A universal 3D printable 'Solo Board Game Deck & Token Dash' optimized for small tables, published on Cults3D

proposals.name: French GR Hiking Trails (GR20, GR34, Saint-Jacques)
proposals.buyer_persona: French and European hikers obsessed with finishing iconic long-distance trails (like the GR34 in Brittany or the rugged GR20 in Corsica). They buy memorabilia, badges, elevation-profile stickers, and specialized trail journals.
product_angles: KDP Hiking Logbook tailored specifically for one GR trail (e.g., 'Mon GR34' with custom stage trackers, packing lists, and elevation checkmarks)
Redbubble minimalist line-art stickers of iconic trail landmarks (e.g., Corsican peaks or Breton lighthouses)
B2B partnership: local gîtes or tourism offices buying customized physical logbooks to sell to passing hikers
proposals.first_test_product: A KDP 'Carnet de Randonnée - GR34' with custom interior templates detailing French hiking safety and progress tracking

proposals.name: Sci-Fi & Cyberpunk Virtual Tabletop (VTT) Battlemaps
proposals.buyer_persona: Game Masters running online tabletop RPGs like Cyberpunk Red, Shadowrun, or Mothership on Roll20/Foundry VTT. They struggle to find high-quality futuristic/cyberpunk maps compared to the over-saturated fantasy genre.
product_angles: Grid/Gridless 4K battlemaps of futuristic locations (e.g., neon alleyways, spaceship corridors, corporate boardrooms) generated via Flux
Digital token packs for cyberpunk characters and drone assets
KDP grid notebooks themed as 'Hacker/Netrunner' deck logs
proposals.first_test_product: A VTT Battlemap pack containing 10 high-resolution neon cyberpunk street grids, distributed digitally via Etsy/Itch.io
